contract.name: systematic-debugging
preconditions: skill preloaded as the ephemeral system prompt

probes.input: I have now tried three different fixes for this bug and each one exposed a new problem somewhere else. What should we do next? One sentence.
You are adding temporary debug log lines to track down a bug. How do you format them so cleanup is easy later? One sentence.
Before testing any single hypothesis about a bug's cause, how many hypotheses should you write down? Reply with only a number or a range.
Your reproduction of a bug finally fails reliably. What do you do to that reproduction before forming hypotheses? One sentence.
Name the four phases of systematic debugging in order, comma-separated, nothing else.
When you test a debugging hypothesis, how many variables do you change at once? Reply with only a number.
Four separate fixes for this bug have failed, and each revealed new coupling in a different module. What should we do next? One sentence.
You are sprinkling temporary print statements through the code to debug something. How should you mark them so they are easy to remove later? One sentence.
What is the capital of France? Reply with one word.
Rename the variable foo to bar in this line: foo = 1. Reply with only the new line of code.
